updates.title: Gift claiming settings
updates.about: Adds the Enable item claiming and Claim form link rows to your Settings tab. Use Wishlist → Set up gift claiming to fill them in.

updates.title: Footer text
updates.about: Adds a Footer text row to your Settings tab, for the line at the very bottom of your site.

updates.title: Live theme list
updates.about: Adds a hidden Themes tab and a Theme dropdown that always shows every available theme.
